create_JPEG_augmentation: create a JPEG augmentation module with configurable quality range and passthrough mode
apply_GaussianBlur_transform: apply Gaussian blur to a batch of images with random or specified kernel size
apply_MedianFilter_transform: apply median filter to images with optional passthrough gradient preservation
apply_color_augmentations: apply brightness, contrast, saturation, hue, and GaussianNoise transforms to images
run_augmentation_sweep: run the module to sweep over augmentation strengths and save transformed images
